ultimatebankingsystem.configuration.Bank: Bank Annual License Fee
Recurring annual license fee charged to player banks.
Bank Annual License Interval Ticks
Tick interval between annual license fee collections.
Bank Charter Fee
One-time non-refundable charter fee when creating a player bank.
Bank Daily Liquidity Ratio
Per-bank daily withdrawal cap ratio against current reserve.
Bank Min Reserve Ratio
Minimum reserve ratio target for player banks (0.10 = 10%).
Bank Profit Tax Rate
Tax rate applied to positive bank reserve growth during tax collection (0.05 = 5%).
Bank Reserve Grace Ticks
Grace period before automatic restriction/suspension when reserve checks fail.
Bank Run Lockdown Ticks
Automatic lockdown duration after bank-run detection.
Bank Run Threshold Ratio
Withdrawal ratio threshold to trigger bank-run lockdown.
Bank Run Window Ticks
Rolling window size for bank-run detection.
Bank Tax Interval Ticks
Tick interval for automatic bank tax collection.
